file_metadata.authority: Dolnytsky Typikon Part I (Matins) & Part IV (Triodion)
file_metadata.scope: Complete Matins Matrix (Great, Daily, Lenten, Passion, Tomb, Bright)
file_metadata.description: Defines the distinct orders of Matins with role-based rubrics derived directly from Dolnytsky.

great_matins.source_ref: Dolnytsky I: Order of Great Matins

roles.priest: Vested in Epitrachelion and Phelonion. Stand before the Holy Table. Exclaim 'Glory to the Holy...'
roles.choir: Sing 'Amen' and 'Glory to God in the Highest' (3x).

roles.priest: Vest in Epitrachelion. Exit North Door. Stand before closed Holy Doors. Exclaim 'Blessed is our God'.
roles.choir: Sing Introductory Prayers (Trisagion, Troparia, 'Lord Have Mercy' 12x).
roles.deacon: Perform the Great Censing of the whole church during the Psalms.
Intone verses before the Icon of Christ.
roles.choir: Sing the Troparion of the Feast/Saint.

rubric.title: The Kathismata
rubric.note: Two Kathismata are read. On Sundays, the Polyeleos follows.
Sung without exclamation — priest exclaims only at the end of the kathisma block.

roles.priest: Exclaim 'For Thine is the dominion' (quietly, sitting at place)

rubric.note: Sung without exclamation — priest exclaims 'For Thine is the dominion' only here, concluding the full kathisma block.

roles.priest: Exclaim 'For Thine is the dominion' (aloud) — this is the one exclamation for the two-kathisma block.
If Polyeleos: Open Holy Doors, Great Censing. If Kathisma 17: Remain in altar.

rubric.title: The Canon
rubric.note: Combined from Octoechos, Menaion, and Triodion according to rank.

roles.priest: [Vigil only] Anoint the faithful with blessed oil during the Canon (Dolnytsky I: 'according to custom', applicable at All-Night Vigil form).

rubric.title: Eighth Ode - Special Refrains
rubric.note: Instead of 'Glory' → 'Let us bless the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit'. Katavasia intro: 'We praise, we bless, we worship the Lord'

rubric.title: Post-Ode 9 Hymn
rubric.note: Non-Sunday: 'It is truly meet'. Sunday: 'Holy is the Lord our God' (3x)

roles.priest: Great Doxology (Sung) or Small Doxology (Read) depending on rank.

rubric.title: Post-Doxology Rite
rubric.note: For Cross Veneration etc.

daily_matins.source_ref: Dolnytsky I: Order of Daily Matins

rubric.title: The Kathismata
rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky I:204 - 'to the second Sessional Hymn inclusive'
rubric.note: Two or three Kathismata with Sessional Hymns, same as Great Matins.

rubric.title: The Canon
rubric.note: Katavasia is irmos of last canon, not current seasonal.
At 9th Ode priest censes as at Great Matins.

roles.reader: Read Psalms 148-150 without singing, without stichera.

roles.priest: Exclaim 'Glory to Thee Who hast shown us the light'.

rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky I:204 - 'troparion of the Saint is sung'
Dolnytsky I:204 - 'Dismissal Theotokion...according to the tone'
Dolnytsky I:204 - 'Blessed is He Who Is'

rubric.title: Alleluia & Trinity Hymns
rubric.note: Instead of 'God is the Lord' we sing Alleluia in the sequential tone.
Three commemorations: weekday, all saints, Theotokos.

rubric.title: Three Kathismata with Prostrations
rubric.note: At 'Alleluia' of each 'Glory' of Kathismata—3 prostrations.

rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV:202 - 'After It is truly meet—1 prostration'

rubric.note: Trinity Exapostilarion of the tone, three times with commemorations.

rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV:232 - 'at Glory to God in highest—3 prostrations'
Dolnytsky IV:234 - 'It is a good thing' twice
Dolnytsky IV:234 - 'Troparion Standing in the temple'
Dolnytsky IV:234 - 'after last prostration, immediately O come let us worship'
rubric.note: No dismissal. 1st Hour begins immediately.
Psalm 50 is read, followed by the intercession verse. 'Glory: Through the prayers of the Apostles' or saint-specific by rank.

roles.reader: Read 'Have mercy on me, O God' (v.3) then Glory: intercession verse.

bridegroom_matins.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV: Lines 554-580 (Holy Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday of Passion Week)

rubric.title: Alleluia and Bridegroom Troparion
rubric.note: Instead of the Trinity hymns, the Bridegroom troparion is sung three times.

roles.choir: Sing 'Behold the Bridegroom comes at midnight' three times in the tone of the day.

rubric.title: Bridegroom Canon (Triodion or Diodion)
rubric.note: Monday and Wednesday: full triodion canon from Holy Week Triodion. Tuesday: diodion (Odes 8 and 9 only). Menaion suppressed on all three days.

roles.choir: Sing the Exapostilarion of the Bridegroom from the Holy Week Triodion.

rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV:568 - Aposticha from the Holy Week Triodion
rubric.note: Aposticha are from the Holy Week Triodion proper to the day (not general Lenten Triodion).

rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV:572 - Bridegroom troparion as closing dismissal troparion
rubric.note: 'Behold the Bridegroom comes at midnight' sung once as the final troparion before the 1st Hour.

tomb_matins.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV: Jerusalem Matins of Great Saturday (Appendix + Part IV)

rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV: Great Saturday — In place of God is the Lord, Alleluia is sung

rubric.title: Three Stations of Psalm 118 with Encomia
rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV: Great Saturday — The Lamentations (Encomia)
rubric.note: Kathisma 17 (Psalm 118) is read in three stations (staseis), with Encomia stichera interspersed at each verse. Priest censes at each station.

roles.choir: After each verse, sing the corresponding Encomion from Encomia I.
Sing Encomia II stichera at each verse.

rubric.title: Third Station — Psalm 118:132–176
rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV: Encomia III (44 verses + Theotokion + Trisagion)

roles.choir: Sing Encomia III. After the Theotokion: Trisagion is read.

rubric.note: Evlogitaria of the Resurrection (Sunday Matins tone)
Hypakoe of the current Octoechos tone
Anabathmoi — Tone 5 (fixed for Great Saturday)

rubric.title: Canon of Great Saturday
rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV: Odes 1, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9 — heirmos sung twice
rubric.note: Canon of Great Saturday uses only Odes 1, 3, 6, 7, 8, and 9 (not the full 9-ode scheme). Each heirmos is sung twice — once as opening, once as katavasia (both choirs together).

rubric.title: Procession with the Shroud
rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV: Great Saturday — After Great Doxology

roles.priest: Vested in epitrachelion and phelonion. Take the shroud (plashchanytsia) on head, preceded by candle-bearers and censer. Process around the church singing Encomia.
roles.choir: Sing the Encomia stichera (Station III reprise) during the procession.
roles.deacon: Walk before the priest with the censer.

rubric.note: Return through the Royal Doors. Place shroud on the tetrapod in the center of the church.

passion_matins.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV: Lines 626–653 — Service of the Holy and Saving Passion (Great Friday)
passion_matins.note: Celebrated Thursday evening, after sunset, at the 2nd hour of the night (line 631). Analogion with Gospel placed before Holy Doors (line 632). 12 Gospels interspersed throughout the service.

rubric.title: Opening Rite
rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV:634 — 'from the usual beginning... as at Matins daily'

roles.priest: Vest. Begin: 'Blessed is our God.' Cense during opening psalms (Pss. 19 & 20).

rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV:637 — 'Instead of God is the Lord we sing Alleluia in the tone of the troparion'
Dolnytsky IV:638-639 — Troparion twice, Glory Both now: once more
rubric.note: During the third singing: priest vests in violet phelonion, comes before altar steps, opens Holy Doors, censes table, iconostasis, chanters, people, returns, sings small litany without exclamation, goes to analogion.

roles.choir: 'When the glorious disciples were enlightened' — twice; Glory, Both now: once.
roles.priest: During third singing: vest, open Holy Doors, cense, return, sing small litany (without exclamation), process to analogion.

rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV:639 — small litany without exclamation before 1st Gospel
rubric.note: This is the ONLY small litany before a Gospel. Between subsequent Gospels (2-12), no small litany is sung (Dolnytsky IV:634).

roles.priest: Read from analogion. Before: 'Wisdom! Upright! Let us hear the Holy Gospel.' Choir: 'Glory to Thy Passion, O Lord.' After: 'Glory to Thy long-suffering, O Lord.' Bells ring after each Gospel.

rubric.title: Antiphons 1–3 and Sessional Hymn I
rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV:644 — Three antiphons of Passion troparia + Sessional Hymn
rubric.note: Each troparion is repeated (antiphonally). Theotokion at 'Glory, Both now' is not repeated. Priest censes.

rubric.title: Beatitudes with Prokeimenon
rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV:645 — 'Beatitudes with Prokeimenon and then the 7th Gospel. Stichera on 7, with Glory Both now = 9.'
Dolnytsky IV:646 — 'Psalm 50 and the eighth Gospel'
rubric.note: No Save O God / Through the Resurrection interpolation here (that belongs to Bridegroom Matins; this is the Passion form).

rubric.title: Canon — Triodion (Three-Ode)
rubric.note: Troparia on 12. Heirmoi twice (first as opening, second as katavasia, both choirs). After Ode 5: small litany + Kontakion + Ikos. At Ode 9: no More Honorable, no It is truly meet. After Ode 9 Katavasia: small litany, then Exapostilarion.

rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV:647 — 'Exaposteilarion Thy bridal chamber × 3 (with Glory Both now)'
Dolnytsky IV:648 — 'Stichera of Praises on 4, Glory: one sticheron, Both now: another'
Dolnytsky IV:650 — 'Litany Let us complete... after exclamation — immediately the 11th Gospel'

rubric.note: After the 12th Gospel: bells CEASE permanently until the Resurrection. Wooden clappers (bila) used from this point (Dolnytsky IV:634).

rubric.source_ref: Dolnytsky IV:652 — Troparion 'Thou hast redeemed' (Tone 2, no theotokion)
Dolnytsky IV:653 — Intermediate dismissal (not combined with 1st Hour)
rubric.note: 'Wisdom!' / 'More honorable…' / 'Glory to Thee, O Christ our God, our hope, glory to Thee.' The 1st Hour is NOT attached.

roles.clergy: Process around the church singing 'Thy Resurrection O Christ Savior'.

roles.priest: Exclaim 'Glory to the Holy...' before closed doors. Sing 'Christ is Risen' with verses.
Hold the Cross. Greet faithful 'Christ is Risen'.
